# [TASK] Setup Docker Compose Infrastructure

## Task
Docker Compose setup for local development: PostgreSQL, MongoDB and Redis
with healthchecks and persistent volumes, plus start and stop scripts.

## Parent Story
Parent: #83

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] PostgreSQL, MongoDB and Redis each declare a healthcheck
      (`ProjectStructureTest.composeDefinesThreeDatabasesWithHealthchecksAndNamedVolumes`)
- [x] Each of the three declares a named volume, so data survives a
      recreate
      (`ProjectStructureTest.composeDefinesThreeDatabasesWithHealthchecksAndNamedVolumes`)
- [x] `start-infrastructure.sh` and `stop-infrastructure.sh` exist and are
      executable
      (`test -x infrastructure/scripts/start-infrastructure.sh`)
- [x] `infrastructure/docker/.env.example` documents the configurable
      variables, currently 34
      (`grep -cE '^[A-Z_]+=' infrastructure/docker/.env.example`)
- [x] The compose file parses and resolves
      (`docker compose -f infrastructure/docker/docker-compose.yml config -q`)

## Estimate
**Hours:** 5

## Notes
The fourth criterion did not say where `.env.example` was. There is no
root-level copy; the file is at `infrastructure/docker/.env.example`.

The last criterion recorded a live check on 2025-11-14. Replaced with the
compose validation command, which is re-runnable. The compose file has
grown from 3 services to 19 since this issue closed.
